name: eXDetective
source:
You play as a detective who died after a life of crime fighting and then found himself a ghost in what is called the afterlife. Anyway, there is no crime in the afterlife, so our detective has changed his jobs into helping women.

[From Itch.io]
translation:
你扮演一名侦探，在一生的犯罪斗争中死去，然后发现自己在所谓的来世里变成了鬼魂。无论如何，来世没有犯罪，所以我们的侦探将他的工作改为帮助女性。

[来自Itch.io]
